summary: Aura personal AI assistant — both backend and frontend tested end-to-end. All 30 backend pytest cases passed (tasks/habits/expenses/health/reminders/journal/mood/dashboard CRUD + Claude chat with INR + Whisper 4xx-without-file). Frontend mobile flows verified across all 8 screens: Home dashboard renders with greeting/clock/stats/mood chips/streak/next reminder; bottom nav navigates between all 8 tabs (Home/Tasks/Habits/Money/Health/Alerts/Journal/Aura); add-task with priority works; expense FAB+total update to ₹192; water inc, calorie +100, workout toggle work; reminder preset (30m) works; journal mood+save works; Claude AI chat returns memory-aware INR answer ('You spent ₹192 on food today... ₹42 chai + ₹150 lunch'). No red screens, no page errors. Voice mic icon visible (recording will fail on web — expected, expo-audio).

issues: Multiple console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Animated useNativeDriver fallback. Cosmetic only — does not affect functionality on web.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with boxShadow in StyleSheets to silence RN web warnings.
Note: react-native-svg installed at 15.15.4 but Expo expects 15.12.1 — may cause Expo Go mismatch warnings; consider `npx expo install react-native-svg` if targeting Expo Go strictly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines — within acceptable limits but consider splitting routers per resource if it grows.
Single USER_ID='default_user' single-user model is intentional per PRD; document this if multi-user expected later.
Chat memory context is rebuilt on every call (could be cached if expense/journal counts grow), but fine for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (all 8 screens load, all CRUD flows tested work)

seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ created during test run (task, expense, reminder, journal) — all cleaned up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testIDs reference: home (home-greeting, home-clock, home-streak, stat-tasks/habits/expenses/water, mood-{great|good|okay|low|stressed}, next-reminder-card), ambient (ambient-bar, ambient-mic-btn, ambient-tts-btn, ambient-text), nav (nav-home/tasks/habits/expenses/health/reminders/journal/ai), tasks (add-task-fab, new-task-input, new-task-prio-{high|medium|low}, new-task-submit, filter-{all|pending|done}, task-toggle-{id}, task-delete-{id}), expenses (add-expense-fab, expense-desc-input, expense-amount-input, expense-submit, expenses-total), health (water-inc/dec, cal-plus-100/300, cal-minus-100, workout-toggle), reminders (add-reminder-fab, reminder-title-input, preset-{30m|1h|tonight|tomorrow}, repeat-{once|daily|weekly}, reminder-submit), journal (journal-mood-{great|good|okay|low|stressed}, journal-input, journal-save), ai (chat-input, chat-send, chat-mic). Use viewport 390x844. Voice mic on web is expected to fail (expo-audio is mobile-only) — not a bug.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. Backend Claude integration confirmed working — returns Indian rupee (₹) formatted answers using user's actual data.
